messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin (KMO)
parts:
Hi
install the package psych , if it is not installed on your R, then use the functions KMO() and cortest.bartlett(). that is to say:

install.packages("psych",dep=T)   # if the psych package installed in your R ignore this line 
library(psych)
dat<- read.table("C:\\Users\\Diya Guha Roy\\Desktop\\Articles\\Article 4\\DATA_New.txt") # i do not know 
 # the type of your daya it is my guess
kmo <-KMO(dat)
kmo
bart <- cortest.bartlett(dat)
bart
